name: Klaus-Dieter Richter
bio: Klaus-Dieter's journey into motorsport began in his youth, captivated by the precision engineering of Formula One cars. He honed his skills at the Technical University of Munich, specializing in aerodynamics and vehicle dynamics. After graduating, he joined a smaller racing team, learning the ropes of race engineering before progressing to Red Bull Racing. Klaus-Dieter is known for his meticulous approach and relentless pursuit of performance gains. He believes in data-driven decisions, constantly seeking to optimize every aspect of the car. His experience allows him to quickly identify and address potential issues, making him a valuable asset to the team. He is also known for his ability to mentor junior engineers.
